summary: Iter6: Validated Blog/Articles (public list/read, RBAC, slug upsert, PATCH, soft-delete), Rank AI webhook with X-Webhook-Secret (401 wrong/missing, 200 flat + envelope payloads → source='rank.ai'), day-level analytics (/analytics/heatmap returns 7x24 grid, /analytics/dod returns today/yesterday/day_before/trail, /analytics/agent-daily 403 for agents), workflow filtering on agent GET /workflows. 20 new tests added in test_articles_analytics.py, all pass. Full regression: 124/124 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke: /blog renders with Helmet meta, /blog/{slug} renders article with JSON-LD BlogPosting + title in schema, Analytics page shows dod-strip + heatmap (168 cells) + agent-daily-chart, UserManagement edit dialog shows ALLOWED WORKFLOWS section for agent role with 5 workflow checkboxes. Found + fixed 2 backend bugs: (1) RANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET read at module import time before load_dotenv ran → moved to request-time read; (2) /api/sitemap defined AFTER app.include_router(api) so endpoint never mounted → moved router include below endpoint definition. Both fixes verified.

minor.issue: RANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET was read at articles.py module import, but server.py calls load_dotenv() AFTER importing articles → secret was always empty in process env → endpoint returned 503 'Webhook not configured'. Fixed by reading env at request time via _get_webhook_secret() helper.
Endpoint was decorated AFTER app.include_router(api) call, so it never registered. Returned 404. Fixed by moving router include below endpoint definition.

issues: og:type still resolves to 'website' on the article page (the index.html base meta dominates). Helmet should override og:type='article' for SEO best practice on article pages. Minor; rich results still work because JSON-LD BlogPosting is present and detected.

server.py:1062 — placing app.include_router(api) BEFORE all @api.get() decorators is a latent bug template. Suggest moving include_router(api) to the very END of the file, after ALL decorators are bound to the router, OR document the constraint at the include line.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (webhook 503): Classic load_dotenv timing — articles.py line 21 read os.environ.get('RANK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') at module import, but server.py imports articles.py at line 30 BEFORE calling load_dotenv() at line 34. So when articles.py executed, the .env hadn't been loaded yet and the secret was empty. Fix: move env read to request-time inside a helper function _get_webhook_secret(). Bug 2 (/api/sitemap 404): The @api.get('/sitemap') decorator was placed AFTER `app.include_router(api)`. FastAPI snapshots routes when include_router is called, so any subsequent decorations on the api router are not visible to the app. Fix: move app.include_router(api) to AFTER all @api.get decorators in the file. Both fixes verified live.
